description:
FILED s473t3 (Opus triage of the 79 CATALOG-only blessed rows), on main
d9a2aac0.  PRE-EXISTING.  Probe: scratch/s473t3/probes/p17-qr-pvlv.pl.

ROWS BEHIND IT (baselines/fail-baseline.tsv, 3 rows):
  qr.t 22 `stored regexp`         (a tie STORE sees `ref \pop`)
  qr.t 29 `PVLVs`                 (`ref \$_[0]` after `$_[0] = ${qr=...=}`)
  qr.t 31 `copying a regexpvlv`   (`my $x = $_[0]; ref \$x`)

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl):
    my $d = ${ qr/abc/ };
    print "ref-of-ref=[", ref(\$d), "] str=[$d]\n";
    sub { $_[0] = ${ qr=crumpets= };
          print "PVLV : ", ref(\$_[0]), "\n";
          print "match: ", (" crumpets " =~ $_[0] ? 1 : 0), "\n";
          my $x = $_[0];
          print "copy : ", ref(\$x), "\n"; }->(my $slot);
  perl: ref-of-ref=[REGEXP] str=[(?^:abc)]  PVLV: REGEXP  match: 1  copy: REGEXP
  PCL : ref-of-ref=[SCALAR] str=[(?^:abc)]  PVLV: SCALAR  match: 1  copy: SCALAR
  The STRINGIFICATION and the MATCH are correct in PCL -- the value behaves
  like a regexp everywhere except when a reference to it is typed.

MECHANISM: `${qr//}` yields a plain scalar box; `p-ref` reports REGEXP only
when the box's inner value is a `p-regex-match` struct, and the dereferenced
value is not.  perl's `${qr//}` is a REGEXP-typed SV, so a reference to it
(and to any copy of it) types as REGEXP.  Fix area: `p-cast-$` /
`p-ref` in `cl/pcl-runtime.lisp` -- carry the regexp type through the deref.
Session 207 fixed `ref(\$qr)` (the reference to the qr ITSELF); this is the
DEREFERENCED value, which it did not cover.

CATALOG NOTE THIS REPLACES: sweep-bug-catalog.md qr.t, "PVLV deref
`${qr//}` ... should return a magical PVLV that stringifies to the pattern.
Complex.  Not supported." -- narrower than that: it DOES stringify and match
correctly; only the ref TYPE is wrong.

FAMILY: ref-type reporting; sibling #1487 (the write half).
subject: BUG (qr//): a reference to the value of `${qr//}` reports SCALAR where perl reports REGEXP -- `my $x = ${qr=crumpets=}; ref \$x` is `REGEXP` in perl and `SCALAR` in PCL
